battle.name: 吉爾多尼克叛亂
battle.brief: 狄奧多西一世於三九五年病逝後，阿非利加總督吉爾多尼克截留稅賦、拒絕上繳西廷，攝政斯提利柯原擬以大軍渡海遠征，最終改由赫拉克利烏斯率精兵於三九八年在塞瓦河谷破其主力，叛首敗走毛里塔尼亞而死。卡面秦弩並未出現於此役，它代表的是同一存力投射技術的源頭。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場衝突是西羅馬帝國與其行省總督吉爾多尼克之間的一場內戰，形式上是平叛，實質上是帝國西半部對一位蠻族出身的權臣在財政與名分上的爭奪。交戰一方是霍諾留斯治下的西羅馬：皇帝自三九五年狄奧多西一世病逝後仍是一名少年，實權落在攝政兼野戰軍統帥斯提利柯手中，加上元老院、執政官與近衛總監構成的常設機構；作戰序列是西部野戰軍的精銳部隊，由將領赫拉克利烏斯率領，輔以由海路輸送的後勤船隊。另一方是占據阿非利加行省三年之久的吉爾多尼克：他以法蘭克人出身，於三八六年被任命為該行省總督，先平定了毛里塔尼亞人菲爾穆斯的叛亂，隨後以個人權力接管了羅馬最富庶的行省；他的軍隊由法蘭克與日耳曼裔近衛骨幹、本地羅馬駐軍以及柏柏爾與努米底亞的騎兵拼成，編制上仍套用帝國晚期的軍團與輔兵大隊框架，但指揮權完全集中在他一人之手，親信分據要衝。雙方都沒有另一支獨立的羅馬軍隊可用來制衡：帝國西部的野戰軍幾乎全在斯提利柯手中，一旦調兵北非，意大利與多瑙河防線就只剩下象徵性的守備，這正是後來元老院出面阻攔全軍遠征的真正著眼點。
countriesEn: This conflict was a civil war inside the Western Roman Empire, fought between the imperial government and its own provincial governor, Gildonac (usually called Gildo), over money and over obedience. On one side stood the West under the child emperor Honorius: since the death of Theodosius I in 395 the boy king had no power of his own, and real authority rested with the regent and magister militum Stilicho, together with the permanent machinery of the Senate, the quaestor and the praetorian prefect. The field force was a picked detachment of the western field army under the general Flavius Aelius Heraclius, supported by a supply fleet moving by sea. On the other side stood Gildonac, who had held the province of Africa for three years: a Frank appointed comes Africae in 386 and given the task of putting down the revolt of Firmus in Mauretania; after that victory he simply kept the province and its revenues, becoming the holder of the richest single command in the empire. His army was a patchwork of Frankish and Germanic personal guards, local Roman troops, and Berber and Numidian cavalry, still wearing the late imperial frame of legions and auxiliary cohorts, but with command concentrated entirely in his own hands and trusted men posted to the key positions. What is remarkable is that neither side had a second independent Roman army to balance the other: virtually the entire field army of the West was in Stilicho's grip, so moving troops to Africa left Italy and the Rhine line defended by token garrisons only. That is exactly the point on which the Senate later pressed its objection to a full-scale invasion.
people: 核心人物是叛軍首領吉爾多尼克，本名吉爾多，晚期羅馬作家稱他為吉爾多尼克，出身法蘭克部族，兄弟中至少有一位是西羅馬的權臣弗拉維烏斯·埃利烏斯·埃提烏斯，後世史家多以兄弟相稱，亦有學者僅視之為同族。三八六年狄奧多西一世把阿非利加交給這位同族將領，讓他討平菲爾穆斯；他以菲爾穆斯的死換取帝國對其權力的承認，並在西廷換主人之後拒絕移交稅賦。攝政斯提利柯是西羅馬這一方的主帥，蠻族與羅馬混血出身，娶狄奧多西的姪女塞雷娜，握有西部野戰軍與朝廷的實權，最後正是他決定用一場小規模遠征取代全軍南下的計劃。執行者是弗拉維烏斯·埃利烏斯·赫拉克利烏斯，狄奧多西的姪女婿，早年以平叛與邊疆戰功晉身將領，這場戰役後取得執政官銜，其青銅石棺後來安放在羅馬的聖安德烈堂。執法官歐赫里烏斯代表元老院，在三九七年以長篇演說勸阻斯提利柯不要遠征，他是把宮廷內部的計算與保留意見留給後世的唯一一人。皇帝方面，霍諾留斯自三九五年起在位至四一一年，阿卡狄烏斯在君士坦丁堡維持對等的帝國；另一端的西哥德王阿拉里克一世被吉爾多尼克視為可以倚重的刀，茲西穆斯指其入侵意大利出自叛軍的慫恿，學界對此多所保留。詩人克勞狄安為這場戰爭寫過長詩《吉爾多尼克戰爭》，詩稿已佚，只餘片段，可見官方如何把它寫成攝政者的另一場捷報。主要史源是茲西穆斯，其後是普羅科匹烏斯；北非泰吉杜爾·米努斯出土的紀念碑銘與羅馬的赫拉克利烏斯石棺，則是這場戰事留下的兩件實物。
peopleEn: The central figure is the rebel leader Gildonac, whose own name was Gildo and whom late Roman writers called Gildonac. He was of Frankish origin, and one of his brothers was Flavius Aetius, the future strongman of the West; later historians commonly treat the two as brothers, though some prefer to call them merely kinsmen of the same people. In 386 Theodosius I handed Africa to this fellow tribesman to deal with Firmus; by the death of Firmus he had exchanged the rebel for imperial recognition of his own power, and when the court changed masters in the West he refused to hand over the revenues. Stilicho was the Roman commander. Of mixed barbarian and Roman blood and married to Theodosius's niece Serena, he held the western field army and the practical power of the court, and it was he who decided to replace a full invasion with a small expedition. The man who carried it out was Flavius Aelius Heraclius, brother-in-law of Theodosius and long since promoted for suppressing revolts and fighting on the frontiers; he received a consulship after this campaign, and his bronze sarcophagus was later set in the church of St Andrew at Rome. The quaestor Eucherius spoke for the Senate and in 397 used a long speech to dissuade Stilicho from invading; he is the only man who left the court's calculations and reservations for posterity. On the imperial side, Honorius reigned from 395 until 411 while Arcadius upheld the equal empire at Constantinople; at the other end of the scale King Alaric of the Visigoths was a blade Gildonac hoped to use, and Zosimus attributes the Visigothic invasion of Italy to rebel instigation, a claim that most scholars hedge. The poet Claudian wrote a long poem on the war, the De Bello Gildonico, of which only fragments survive, showing how the court wished the affair dressed up as another victory for the regent. The main narrative source is Zosimus, followed by Procopius; the commemorative inscription found at Thuburbo Minus in North Africa and the sarcophagus of Heraclius at Rome are the two surviving material traces of the campaign.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩是公元前二世紀的漢弩，與本役相隔近六百年，不會出現在塞瓦河谷的戰場上，但它是理解四世紀投射技術沿革最好的標尺。漢弩的關鍵在於弩機：把弦的拉力預先儲存在機件裡，射手上好弦、扣下扳機即可射出，射速遠勝拉弓；漢代已配備蹶張器上弦，用腳蹬壓機身，箭壓在弩槽待發，士卒可連續送出密集箭雨，更進一步的連弩弩車能以數十發的連射壓制匈奴騎兵。弩機的西傳有兩條路線：其一是經帕提亞與絲道進入中亞，再由東地中海商人轉手，羅馬世界在晚期已能見到仿漢弩的帶機弩；其二是希臘化世界獨立發展出的同類原理，即前二世紀以後出現的 cheiroballista 與 gastrophetes，公元前三世紀的工程師希羅已有記載。羅馬晚期的野戰軍與攻城器械正是站在這條線上：四世紀初特里爾的浮雕清楚刻出車載弩砲與扭力投石機，《軍政大全》（約成書於四百年前後）在西部各防線的名冊中列有專司投射器的弩砲大隊與弓手大隊，這些人在此役中的位置，是隨大軍推進的技術兵種。真正決定塞瓦河谷一戰的，卻是與弩砲無關的東西：羅馬步兵的標槍、短劍與盾，以及從敘利亞與龐提亞海岸募來的弓手大隊和弓騎兵；吉爾多尼克的法蘭克與日耳曼步兵近身纏鬥的本事，則是四世紀高盧戰線反覆證明過的。本役的裝備細節在史料中幾乎全空，只留下地名與人數，因此卡面秦弩在此的真正位置，是量度這一時代「把力量存起來再釋放」這一想法如何從中國的制弩工藝，一路由地中海世界的弩砲繼承下來。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is a Han weapon of the second century BC, nearly six centuries earlier than this campaign, and it cannot have stood on the field at the Saw; it is nonetheless the best yardstick for tracing the line of projectile technology through the fourth century. The heart of the Han crossbow was the lock: the strain of the string was stored in the mechanism beforehand, so that a soldier who had cocked the bow only had to squeeze the trigger to loose, and the rate of fire far exceeded that of the bow. The Han already cocked with a foot lever pressed against the stock, laid the bolt in the groove, and could deliver dense volleys; the repeating crossbow mounted on a cart went further and kept up a stream of several dozen bolts against Xiongnu horse. The lock travelled west by two routes. One ran through Parthia and the silk roads into Central Asia and was then passed on by eastern Mediterranean traders, so that the late Roman world already knew framed crossbows modelled on the Chinese type. The other was an independent development of the same principle in the Hellenistic world, the cheiroballista and the gastrophetes that appear after the second century BC and are described by the engineer Hero of Alexandria in the third century. The late Roman field army and its siege train stood directly on that line: a relief from Trier of the early fourth century clearly shows a cart-mounted ballista and an onager, and the Notitia Dignitatum, compiled around AD 400, lists units of balistarii and sagittarii in the garrison rolls of the western frontiers; in this campaign their place was that of technical troops advancing with the army. What actually decided the battle at the Saw had nothing to do with artillery: the pilum, the gladius and the shield of the Roman infantry, the archer cohorts and mounted archers recruited from the Syrian and Pontic coasts, and the close-quarter prowess of Gildonac's Frankish and Germanic foot, a quality the Gallic front had demonstrated repeatedly in the fourth century. The sources preserve almost no detail of equipment, only place-names and numbers of men, so the true position of the card's crossbow here is as a measure of how the idea of storing force and releasing it in one motion passed from Chinese lockwork to the ballistae of the Mediterranean world.
tactics: 這場戰爭留下的作戰細節不多，但可以確定的骨架相當清楚。三九七年，斯提利柯原本打算以大軍渡海直取阿非利加：從意大利出發、以海運補給、攻入行省核心。元老院在執法官歐赫里烏斯的勸說下提出三點：海路補給難以持久、非洲遠征會掏空西部野戰軍、而意大利與多瑙河線會同時暴露在阿拉里克面前。斯提利柯接受勸告，改為派遣一支規模小得多的精銳部隊，由赫拉克利烏斯率領；他的選擇是打一個時間差：叛軍主力正往西邊迎擊，羅軍卻已在毛里塔尼亞海岸登陸，向東推進，形成對進。三九八年的塞瓦河谷之戰，茲西穆斯的記述保留了幾個可用的細節：羅軍夜間行軍，於天明時接戰，趁叛軍疲於奔命、尚未列陣之際發動；交鋒在炎熱的上午進行，叛軍在平原上被拖入正面消耗，羅馬騎兵自兩翼衝擊，叛軍崩散，統兵者陣亡，營帳與財貨盡為羅軍所得。地形是這一役的關鍵：塞瓦河位於阿非利加行省與毛里塔尼亞的交界地帶，一般認為在今阿爾及利亞西北部、接近摩洛哥邊境，沿河一帶地勢開闊而乾燥，能讓騎兵展開，卻少有可供伏擊的遮蔽物。行軍與補給同樣決定成敗：羅軍輕裝速行，靠海運接濟；叛軍則背著整個行省的財源與城池，必須在原地留下守備。最終毀掉吉爾多尼克的不是任何一種投射兵器，而是距離、乾熱、騎兵的衝鋒節奏，以及西廷對他的財政耐心。
tacticsEn: The campaign left few operational details in writing, but the skeleton of what happened can be fixed. In 397 Stilicho had intended to carry a large army across the sea and strike straight at Africa: departing from Italy, supplied by sea, and driving at the heart of the province. The Senate, speaking through the quaestor Eucherius, pressed three objections: sea supply could not be sustained, a campaign in Africa would drain the western field army, and Italy and the Rhine line would be exposed at the same time to Alaric. Stilicho accepted the advice and instead sent a much smaller force of picked troops under Heraclius; his idea was to exploit a difference in timing, with the rebel main force marching west to meet the enemy while the Roman force landed on the Mauretian coast and pushed east, so that the two sides converged. Zosimus preserves several usable details of the battle at the Saw in 398: the Roman column marched by night and attacked at first light, catching the rebels tired from their march and not yet formed up; the fighting took place during a hot morning, the rebels were drawn into a frontal exhaustion on the plain, Roman cavalry charged both wings, the rebel line broke, its commander was killed, and the camp with its plunder fell intact to the Romans. Terrain was decisive. The Saw lay on the frontier between the province of Africa and Mauretania, generally placed in north-western Algeria near the Moroccan border, where the country about the river is open and dry, good for cavalry to deploy and poor in the kind of cover that invites ambush. Marching and supply mattered just as much: the Roman force travelled light and drew its supplies from the sea, while the rebels carried the wealth and the cities of a whole province and had to leave detachments behind to hold them. What destroyed Gildonac was not any kind of projectile weapon, but distance, dry heat, the rhythm of the cavalry charge, and the fiscal patience of the western court.
data: 可用的數字不多，且多為量級而非確數。時間線最清楚：狄奧多西一世於三九五年一月十七日病逝，帝國自此東西分立，帝位由幼子霍諾留斯與阿卡狄烏斯分據東西；同年吉爾多尼克停止上繳非洲稅賦，衝突以財政形式開始；三九七年元老院勸阻全軍遠征；三九八年春末夏初赫拉克利烏斯在塞瓦河谷取勝；吉爾多尼克敗走毛里塔尼亞後不久死去，戰事在一年之內收束。月份方面，本條目所列的五月是依春末至夏初的通行理解所取的代表值，並非史料記載的確切日期；戰場的具體位置亦有爭議，一般落在今阿爾及利亞西北部、靠近摩洛哥邊境的塞瓦河谷一帶，距離迦太基約三百公里。兵力方面，斯提利柯原擬投入的是數萬量級的野戰軍，最後只派出一支以精銳為主的部隊，茲西穆斯以人數不多而素質優良形容之；吉爾多尼克一方的軍隊沒有留下可靠總數，僅能從其涵蓋法蘭克近衛、本地步兵與大量騎兵這一點，判斷為以萬計。另一組可以核對的數字屬於制度而非戰鬥：《軍政大全》約成書於四百年，特里爾浮雕刻於四世紀初，赫拉克利烏斯兩度出任執政官，第一次在三九三年，第二次在四〇八年。戰後四年即四〇二年與四〇三年的波倫提亞與維羅納之戰，以及四一〇年西哥德攻陷羅馬，說明西部的戰局並未因這場平叛而穩定。
dataEn: Few usable figures survive, and most are orders of magnitude rather than exact counts. The chronology is the firmest thing about it: Theodosius I died on 17 January 395, and the empire was permanently divided, the throne passing to the boy emperors Honorius in the West and Arcadius in the East. In that same year Gildonac stopped remitting the revenues of Africa, and the conflict began in fiscal form; in 397 the Senate dissuaded the grand invasion; in the late spring or early summer of 398 Heraclius won at the Saw; Gildonac fled into Mauretania and died shortly afterwards, so the whole affair closed within a year. As for the month, the May given in this entry is a representative value taken from the usual reading of a late spring to early summer campaign, and is not a date preserved in the sources. The precise site of the battle is also disputed, and is generally placed in the valley of the Saw in north-western Algeria near the Moroccan border, roughly three hundred kilometres from Carthage. On numbers of men, Stilicho had intended to commit a field army in the tens of thousands and in the end sent a force of picked troops, which Zosimus describes as not numerous but of good quality; no reliable total exists for Gildonac's army, and it can only be judged as numbering in the tens of thousands from the mixture of Frankish guards, local foot and a large body of horse. A second set of figures belongs to institutions rather than to the fighting: the Notitia Dignitatum was compiled around AD 400, the Trier relief was cut in the early fourth century, and Heraclius held the consulship twice, first in 393 and again in 408. Four years after the victory, the battles of Pollentia and Verona in 402 and 403, and the sack of Rome by the Visigoths in 410, show that the western situation was not settled by this suppression.
cause: 起因是一連串政治與財政的算計。三九五年狄奧多西一世病逝，帝國被切成兩半：西部只剩霍諾留斯這個尚在稚齡的皇帝與一個沒有親兵、靠蠻族將領撐持的攝政者，東部則由樞密院首魯菲努斯與將領蓋納斯主持。吉爾多尼克正是在這個真空裡坐大：三八六年狄奧多西把阿非利加交給他，讓他平掉菲爾穆斯之亂；仗打完之後，他沒有交還行省，反而把當地財源握在手中，成了帝國西部最富的封邑。他之所以敢於拒絕交稅，除了自恃法蘭克出身將領的兵權，還有一層更深的想法：茲西穆斯記載他慫恿西哥德人入侵意大利，把西部的注意力與兵力拖在亞平寧，給他時間把阿非利加變成與西廷平行的權力中心。這一指控是否出於茲西穆斯的黨爭，學界向有爭論，但西哥德人的進攻確實在他拒繳稅賦之後不久爆發，阿拉里克也確實需要有人為他打開通往意大利的通路。帝國一方的壓力則來自斯提利柯：他不僅要恢復稅收，還要藉一場勝仗鞏固自己對元老院與皇帝的雙重權力，所以必須打，必須贏，而且最好用一次速戰速決的遠征，而不是一場曠日持久的消耗。另一層雜音來自埃提烏斯：吉爾多尼克與他的兄弟關係、以及他本人被元老院指為叛軍內應的嫌疑，成為日後埃提烏斯被貶到達爾馬提亞的伏線。
causeEn: The cause lies in a chain of political and fiscal calculations. When Theodosius I died in 395 the empire was cut in two: in the West there remained only the child emperor Honorius and a regent who had no troops of his own and stood on barbarian generals, while the East was run by the praetorian prefect Rufinus and the general Gainas. Gildonac grew fat in that vacuum. In 386 Theodosius gave him Africa to settle the revolt of Firmus; when the war was over he did not hand the province back but kept its wealth, becoming the richest private fiefdom in the West. His refusal to pay over his dues rested not only on his confidence in the armed force of a Frankish general but on a deeper design: Zosimus records that he incited the Visigoths into Italy, to drag western attention and troops onto the Apennines and buy himself time to turn Africa into a centre of power parallel to the court. Whether that charge reflects Zosimus's own partisanship is much disputed, but the Visigothic attack did come soon after the withholding began, and Alaric did need someone to open the road into Italy. The pressure from the imperial side came from Stilicho, who wanted the revenues restored and also wanted a victory to shore up his double authority over the Senate and the emperor; he had to fight, he had to win, and he preferred a short expedition to a long war of attrition. A second strain of noise came from Aetius: the brotherly tie to Gildonac and the suspicion in the Senate that he was the rebels' accomplice inside the court became the thread that was later pulled to exile Aetius to Dalmatia.
impact: 這場平叛的直接後果，是非洲重新回到帝國的稅收與行政體系之內。非洲的稅賦是西羅馬在四世紀末最重要的一筆收入，失去它意味著西部朝廷的財政幾乎斷了半條腿；吉爾多尼克一死，這筆錢便重新流向皇帝與攝政者的帳房，羅馬城的糧價與軍餉問題也跟著鬆動。更深一層，這是一個範例：即使一位將領握有整個行省的軍隊與稅源，帝國中央仍能在有限時間內用一次小兵力遠征把他拔掉，蠻族將領私人化的模式並非無解。吉爾多尼克的垮台也抽掉了西哥德人方面的助力，西部此後對付阿拉里克的戰事（四〇二年波倫提亞、四〇三年維羅納，直到四一〇年羅馬陷落）是在沒有非洲財源支撐的情況下打的，而斯提利柯本人則在這些戰役中站上了西羅馬的頂峰。但把這場勝利讀成制度性的轉折是不對的：埃提烏斯同樣是法蘭克出身，四〇六年被貶到達爾馬提亞之後仍捲土重來，成為西羅馬真正的強人；帝國對蠻族將軍的依賴並未因吉爾多尼克的死而減少，四〇六年越過萊茵河的日耳曼大潮與四一〇年的羅馬陷落，隨即證明三九八年的順利只是一次僥倖。輿論層面上，克勞狄安的長詩把這場戰爭寫成攝政者替幼主掃清內患的輝煌一役，北非泰吉杜爾·米努斯出土的赫拉克利烏斯紀念碑銘也把勝利刻進石頭；兩個文本都說明當時的西廷需要一個可以拿來講的故事。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the suppression was that Africa was returned to the imperial system of taxation and administration. The revenues of Africa were among the most important sums available to the Western Empire in the late fourth century, and their loss had cut half the support out of the western court; once Gildonac was dead the money flowed back into the accounts of the emperor and the regent, and the problems of grain prices and military pay in Rome eased with it. At a deeper level the campaign was a demonstration: even a general holding the troops and the revenue of an entire province could be removed within a limited time by a small expedition sent from the centre, and the private empire of barbarian generals was not beyond solution. The fall of Gildonac also stripped away the Visigothic connection, and the western wars against Alaric after that, at Pollentia in 402, at Verona in 403 and on down to the sack of Rome in 410, were fought without African money behind them, while Stilicho himself stood at the height of the western empire through those campaigns. It would be wrong, however, to read the victory as a constitutional turning point: Aetius was a Frank as well, and after his exile to Dalmatia in 406 he came back and became the true strongman of the West. The empire's dependence on foreign generals was not diminished by Gildonac's death, and the German flood across the Rhine in 406 and the fall of Rome in 410 showed at once that the smoothness of 398 had been a piece of luck. On the level of public opinion, Claudian's poem dressed the war up as the regent's splendid clearing of the throne's enemies for his young master, and the commemorative inscription of Heraclius from Thuburbo Minus cut the victory into stone; both texts show how much the western court needed a story it could tell.
result: 結果相當明確：叛軍在塞瓦河谷被摧毀，統兵者陣亡，營帳與財貨被羅軍完整奪取；吉爾多尼克本人退入毛里塔尼亞的據點，最後死在那裡，史家對他是自殺還是被部將所殺說法不一，但都在三九八年之內。他的產業被沒收，帝國重新指派官員接管阿非利加，稅課照舊解送西廷，衝突從此不再是叛亂，而是接管的善後。戰術層面，這一役也留下一套可複製的辦法：用一支精銳小部隊在敵人意料之外的地點登陸，逼其主力離開本來的據點，在地形開闊而敵方疲憊的時刻決戰，然後帶著勝利與繳獲迅速回師，不必先為渡海與圍城花掉半個財政年度。代價同樣清楚：遠征需要一位元老院滿意、且願意承擔風險的將領，需要船隊、糧秣與一個明確的財政目標，缺任何一項，斯提利柯原定的全軍南下就會變成一場拖垮西部的冒險。從長期看，吉爾多尼克的死並沒有解決西部面對的真正難題，帝國仍然依賴外來將領與外來士兵，只不過在四一〇年之前，這個難題又被推遲了十二年而已。
resultEn: The result was plain: the rebel army was destroyed at the Saw, its commander was killed, and the camp with its plunder fell whole to the Romans. Gildonac himself withdrew into a stronghold in Mauretania and died there; whether by his own hand or at the hand of one of his men is a matter of dispute among the sources, but it happened within 398. His estates were confiscated, officials were appointed afresh to take over Africa, and the tax was once more remitted to the western court, so that what had been a rebellion became a matter of orderly transfer. At the tactical level the campaign left behind a repeatable method: land a small force of picked troops where the enemy does not expect them, force the rebel main force away from its base, strike at the moment when the ground is open and the enemy is exhausted, and return promptly with the victory and the plunder instead of spending half a fiscal year on the sea crossing and the siege. The costs are just as clear: an expedition needs a commander the Senate trusts and who is willing to carry the risk, and it needs ships, provisions and a definite financial target; lacking any one of them, the full invasion Stilicho had originally planned would have become an adventure that dragged the West down. In the long run Gildonac's death did not solve the real problem the West faced, since the empire still depended on foreign generals and foreign soldiers; the difficulty was merely pushed back twelve years, to 410.
